name: New Parents
overview: Scripture affirms that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as a divine reward and responsibility. Honoring parents is commanded by God, establishing a foundation of respect and obedience within the family. New parents are called to diligently instruct and discipline their children with loving correction, using wisdom and reproof to guide them in the way they should go. This faithful training ensures that children will retain godly principles throughout their lives, reflecting the importance of parental guidance in nurturing spiritual growth.
